name: Page Report
description: Every page under a root (tree walk, root included) with status, last modified/published dates and users, template, template type, created and depth. The root can be a page (one site) or a folder such as /content (every site under it). One run per root path.

inputs.label: Root page paths — one per line (each produces its own file)
inputs.help: A site root (/content/acme) or a folder: /content walks every site under it.

inputs.label: Excluded page subtrees — one per line
inputs.help: Running on /content? Experience fragments, launches, catalogs etc. are pages too: exclude what you don't want.

inputs.label: Max levels below the root (0 = no limit)
inputs.help: Counted from the root you enter: from a site root, 1 = its direct child pages; from /content, 1 = the site roots only. Use 1 or 2 for a quick look at a very large site.

batch.label: Batch: run each site under the entered path as its own run (e.g. /content → every site)
